material_definitions: The study investigates three series of LISICON materials: Li3P(1-x)VxO4, Li(3+x)V(1-x)GexO4, and Li(3+x)P(1-x)GexO4 (where x = 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 and 1).
X-ray diffraction analysis confirms that these samples were phase pure LISICON structures.
Aliovalent substitution of P5+ or V5+ for Ge4+ in Li3PO4 and Li3VO4 creates partial lithium occupancy, leading to much higher conductivities and lower activation energies.
